apps.name: BulletJournal
apps.subtitle: Digital bullet journaling optimized for iPad
apps.versionDescription: Digital bullet journal with enhanced Apple Pencil support featuring pressure sensitivity, tilt recognition, palm rejection, and multiple drawing tools.
apps.localizedDescription: A digital bullet journal web application optimized for iPad and Apple Pencil. Features comprehensive Apple Pencil support with pressure sensitivity, tilt recognition for natural shading, palm rejection for comfortable writing, and multiple drawing tools including pen, marker, highlighter, and eraser. Enjoy a responsive design, offline functionality, and a distraction-free writing mode for the ultimate digital journaling experience.
